faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the CSIR CSMCRI Project Associate – I (PAT-I) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 30th September 2026. It is advisable to send your application well in advance of this deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Associate – I (PAT-I) post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Sc. Degree in Microbiology/Biotechnology/Botany or a B.E/B.Tech degree in Biotechnology/Biochemical Engineering/Fermentation Technology/Bioprocess Engineering/Industrial Biotechnology from a recognized university.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Project Associate – I (PAT-I) post is 35 years. Age relaxation is applicable as per the rules of CSIR.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Associate – I (PAT-I) position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly salary ranging from Rs. 25,000/- + HRA to Rs. 31,000/- + HRA, depending on their qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the CSIR CSMCRI Project Associate – I (PAT-I) recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. You need to prepare your application with all required documents and send it to the official email address specified in the notification before the last date.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Project Associate – I (PAT-I) post?
faq.answer: The selection process involves the scrutiny of applications, followed by an online interview conducted via MS Teams, and finally, document verification.

faq.question: Q8. Where is CSIR CSMCRI located?
faq.answer: CSIR CSMCRI is located in Bhavnagar, Gujarat, with the pincode 364002.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: This is a contractual position. The job type is specified as Contractual.
